notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's family/helper is python-object/PythonObjectDriver, but the upstream MCLockin builds its per-channel Parameters from the deployment config dict in its constructor (levylabinst/MCLockin.py:31-85), so the parameter names exist only after construction and a static family configuration cannot bind them. The package is a direct Driver over the pinned levylabinst.MCLockin:MCLockin class, with native.py constructing it for the hardware backend. The driver serves get_idn, getStatus and the primary measurement path through cap.sensing.read.v1: a requested field is the upstream QCoDeS name <label>_<X|Y|R|Theta|Mean>, resolved through the native config map and _get_lockin. NOT COVERED: the upstream AO configuration setters (_set_amplitude, _set_dc, _set_freq, _set_phase, _set_func), the state setter (_set_state) and sweep1d are not served; the package is a read-only R0 measurement integration because the QCoDeS get_cmd for those setters is _dump, which returns None (levylabinst/MCLockin.py:187-188), so there is no truthful applied-setting readback, and sweep1d is a multi-step routine that blocks in time.sleep and whose stop cannot be guaranteed not to leave the sweep engine active. The device's own analog output state is outside this served interface. The fake is an analytic F0 in-memory stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream simulator; every reading, status word and lead number in fake.py is placeholder test data, while the get_idn dictionary is the literal upstream reply (levylabinst/MCLockin.py:181-186). No hardware was attached or tested; the hardware backend was never imported or run. Hardware deployment assumptions: the clone's setup.py is empty and its modules import qcodes, zmq, numpy and tkinter, so an operator must provide those dependencies, put the pinned clone on PYTHONPATH and supply address and config; the loader refuses an unreviewed model-written hardware backend only at R2/R3 and this package is R0. License: the upstream tree at the pinned commit has no license file; the card's NOASSERTION is carried unchanged, so redistribution remains a maintainer decision. The one gate warning is G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: the suite awards CL2 because SAFE-014 has no limit on an actuating capability to probe; this driver has no actuating capability at all, and every other CL3 test passed. No extension capability ids are used, so catalogue_requests is omitted.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed native.py and the read-only MCLockin/getResults path against the pin; no actuating capability is served and R0 is appropriate. Changed driver.py to validate every requested measurement field before the first measurement query, identify get_idn as a static override, and correct or split the constructor, measurement and state citations. Added the mixed valid/invalid field and missing-measurement cases in test_driver.py, synchronized facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The regression failed before the fix; the final gate and strict collector pass, with only the expected SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE note for a read-only device. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: The identity is hard-coded upstream metadata, not a live instrument identification. AO setters, setState and sweep1d remain outside the served interface; those separate paths can actuate equipment. The hardware deployment must supply qcodes/zmq/numpy/tkinter and an importable pinned clone because setup.py is empty. Construction calls connect_message and close prints to stdout (MCLockin.py:95; ZMQInstrument.py:124-134), so stdio deployments need isolation or output handling; ZMQ timeout/close recovery is not modeled by the fake. NOASSERTION and publish_review=required remain a maintainer publication decision. Evidence is fake contract_checked only; reviewed_by stays null.
